item.title: Platform Introduction
item.description:
KubeSphere employs a fine-grained access control mechanism. The KubeSphere web console displays differently depending on the role of the logged-in user. This section introduces the modules and features of the KubeSphere web console from the perspective of a user with the platform-admin role.
Module Function Top Navigation Bar The top navigation bar displays the management entries for clusters and workspaces by default.
